comment.narrative: Jordan Lebanon IraqProject 73 enhanced the physical protection of critical infrastructures and the preparedness against attacks that may include CBRN materials in 3 countries namely Iraq Jordan and Lebanon. While some of the 10 work packages contained common activities for the three countries most work packages were countryspecific and designed to develop capacitybuilding in a specific field with regard to critical infrastructure protection in each country. It can be assessed that a selected number of critical infrastructures in Middle East benefit from enhanced CBRN protection thanks to the interventions of the project. In addition the Covid 19 response in the 3 partner countries was enhanced through targeted work package. The project contributed towards the following outcomesIraq Enhancing nuclear security physical protection and information security in nuclear research facilities in Iraq Enhanced Covid19 response. Jordan Enhanced protection of critical water infrastructure in Jordan. Enhanced Covid19 response. Lebanon Enhanced protection of critical Command and control chain in Lebanon Enhanced Covid19 response Prevention of additional accidents due to improper storage of dangerous material by MoJ.
